slides.title: Trusted agent execution
slides.subtitle: Inspectable authority, work and evidence
slides.notes: DPF-originated discussion material. No foundation endorsement, certification or complete conformance is claimed. Event dates: https://www.tbmconference.org/ . Request: technical scrutiny and independent reproduction, not adoption.

slides.title: The governed action
body: Current authority is checked at the effect boundary
slides.notes: Editable architecture diagram. Intended semantic chain, not evidence of universal runtime coverage. Family owner: docs/architecture/agent-standards-family.md; normative runtime controls: trusted-ai-kernel.md. Past receipts establish facts, not new execution permission.

slides.title: Four distinct responsibilities
table: Identity, active profile and verifiable claims
Qualification for the job and context
slides.notes: Canonical source: docs/architecture/agent-standards-family.md. Identity claims do not grant authority; qualifications do not grant permission; GPP narrows authority; permission does not prove competence.

slides.title: The MBSE composition
body: Added profile: decision → envelope → effect → assessment
slides.notes: Implementation-profile proposal; no new general language or achieved interchange conformance. https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0 ; https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/1.5 ; https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/ . DPF baseline: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-27-trusted-agent-mbse-baseline-design.md.

slides.title: Decision ownership
body: DPF bindings: WWMD, WWWD and WSID
slides.notes: Each owning scope speaks for its decisions. Cross-scope doctrine is advisory until adopted. Portable contract requires accountable scopes, not DPF acronyms. Finance policy is not invented by platform engineers.

slides.title: Two demonstration contexts
table: Repository scope, gates, tools and evidence
Finance policy, authority and isolated approval
Current profile, bounded effects and refusal paths
slides.notes: Operator selected approval of a synthetic expense. No real money, bank access or external expense integration. Existing backlog retains specimen and reproduction ownership. These are planned contexts, not passed pilots.

slides.title: Synthetic expense walkthrough
body: Show the requirement, owner and work stage
Evaluate evidence against the frozen test policy
Check current authority and GPP binding
Approve only the isolated synthetic record
Inspect the genuine receipt and assertion result
slides.disclosure: STATIC WALKTHROUGH · No execution or recording claimed
slides.notes: STATIC WALKTHROUGH until supported by a separately qualified runtime run. Finance owner must approve thresholds, evidence rules and escalation policy. The packet performs no effect. A recording exists only after an actual governed run is captured and checked.

slides.title: Test permission and refusal
table: Hold or deny under the frozen policy
Held or inconclusive; no invented verdict
slides.notes: Proposed vectors, not executed results. Actual outcomes must bind inputs, profile, policy, GPP, effect identity and evidence. A previous approval cannot authorize an unrelated effect. Infrastructure failure is inconclusive.

slides.title: Business value measurement
body: Include failures, retries, supervision and rework
Keep acceptance, scope and conditions comparable
slides.notes: Proposed complete-cohort metric, not an observed economic result. Do not drop failed attempts from numerator. Correct refusal and completed business work are distinct outcomes. TBM event context: https://www.tbmconference.org/ .

slides.title: Evidence still required
slides.notes: Snapshot2026-10-16; refresh before sharing. Reference code and publication do not complete these obligations. TypeSafe Jev is a bounded-output candidate, not an adopted provider or proven safety control: https://docs.typesafe.ai/introduction . See packet known-gaps.md.

slides.title: Open governance options
slides.notes: Options only. AAIF policy requires permissive release, working implementation, active maintainer, asset/trademark transfer and LF charter; Sandbox is not endorsement. https://github.com/aaif/technical-committee/blob/main/governance/project-lifecycle-policy.md ; https://aaif.io/submit-a-project ; https://jointdevelopment.org/faq/ ; https://github.com/CommunitySpecification/Community_Specification . Existing DPF Apache-2.0 does not settle specification-essential patents or asset transfer.

slides.title: The proposed next step
body: Agree the evidence package before adoption
slides.notes: Proposed spoken request: Would your group review this scoped contract and its negative tests, identify overlap, and help recruit an independent implementer and assessor? No outreach, application, commitment or membership through producing the deck. Existing W3C/IEEE/NIST/IETF venue ownership stays with contribution roadmap.
